product.olivetti-lsx-5020.summary: The 33 MHz i486 LSX with two graphics card choices.
product.olivetti-lsx-5020.history: Olivetti offered the LSX 5000 line to medium-sized businesses and departments of large organisations under its OSA architecture. The German brochure documents the 5020 as the 33 MHz LSX server for multi-user environments.
product.olivetti-lsx-5020.architecture: Video could be matched to the workstation. The brochure offers the VGA-compatible OVC and the 1024 × 768 EISA EVC.
product.olivetti-lsx-5020.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-lsx-5020.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-lsx-5020.olivetti-osa: Olivetti, LSX 5000 System Line in OSA, 1991
